items.title: USCIS Opens Asylum Office in Charlotte
items.summary: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) is opening an asylum office in Charlotte, North Carolina.

items.title: USCIS Announces FY 2027 Inflation Increase for Certain Immigration-Related Fees
items.summary: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services has issued a Federal Register notice that will increase certain H.R. 1 immigration-related fees for fiscal year 2027.

items.title: USCIS Reaches H-2B Cap for First Half of FY 2027
items.summary: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services received enough petitions to meet the congressionally established H-2B cap for the first half of fiscal year (FY) 2027.
